verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS work-management product like Jira, so the axis applies. The pack has no first-party documentation of retention policies, data-deletion controls, or AI-data retention settings. The audit trail (jira-docs-20261109) and REST API are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
